description: A sixteen-bit shift register sequencer after Music Thing Modular's Turing Machine, with the Volts and Pulses expanders built into the same panel

params.text: Sets the voltage this knob adds while its bit of the sequence is high, 0V to 2V from this knob alone and 10V with all five knobs up and all five bits high
Sets how likely a bit is to come round unchanged: fully clockwise the loop repeats exactly, fully counter-clockwise every bit flips on each pass, and between them a bit changes at most half the time
Sets the length of the loop in steps: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 12 or 16
Attenuates the stepped voltage taken from the sequence, which reaches 10V with this knob fully clockwise
Rotates the sequence one place backwards on the next clock, on top of the step that clock makes, and is ignored while a cable is patched to the MOVE input
Rotates the sequence one place forwards on the next clock, on top of the step that clock makes, and is ignored while a cable is patched to the MOVE input
Writes a 1 into the sequence on the next clock, in place of the bit that would have come round; holding the 0 button at the same time writes a 0 instead
Writes a 0 into the sequence on the next clock, in place of the bit that would have come round

inputs.text: Steps the sequence on each rising edge, reading high above 5V and low below 0V
Rotates the sequence back to the start of its loop; it is read only at the instant the clock goes high, and that clock does not step the sequence
Sets the chance of a bit coming round unchanged in place of the big knob while a cable is patched here, -5V to 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel
Rotates the sequence one place backwards on each clock while this reads below -0.05V and one place forwards while it reads above 0.05V, and stops the two MOVE buttons working

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the clock is high and the bit numbered on this jack is high, and 0V the rest of the time
Carries 10V while the clock is high and both bits numbered on this jack are high, or either of them when Pulses mode is set to Or
Carries 10V while the clock is high and all four bits numbered on this jack are high, or any one of them when Pulses mode is set to Or
Twice the sum of the knob voltages whose bits of the sequence are high, reaching 10V with all five knobs up and all five bits high
White noise, roughly -8V to 8V, drawn fresh every sample and unconnected to the sequence
The top eight bits of the sequence read as a number, 0V to 10V before SCALE attenuates it

notes: nothing moves until a clock is patched to CLOCK; the sequence steps only on a rising edge there, and the pulse outputs go high only while that clock is high
menu: Pulses mode — a heading over two choices: And makes a combination output need every bit numbered on it, Or makes it need any one of them
